### What does this PR do?

Adds a Qwen2.5-7B Optimal Token Baseline (OTB) recipe for eight Ascend 910A3 devices with Megatron training and vLLM-Ascend generation, plus a practice report, training curves, and all 101 original metric records. Related task: [verl-ascend-recipe #22](https://github.com/verl-project/verl-ascend-recipe/issues/22).

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Read task #22 and its comments; reviewed [open OTB PRs](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+OTB) (zero results).
- [x] Follow the repository title format.

This recipe uses the OTB implementation from [#6153](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/6153). This contribution adds the Ascend launch recipe and measured training report.

### Test

A GSM8K/MATH run completed 100 updates on eight Ascend 910A3 devices with process/container exit codes 0/0. The measured revision is `release/v0.8.0` at `3e4edb6e`.

| Measurement | Result |
| --- | ---: |
| Mean reward, steps 1–10 / 91–100 | 0.426465 / 0.837500 |
| Final GSM8K / MATH accuracy | 91.2813% / 72.0488% |
| Mean step throughput, prompt + response tokens | 453.6360 tokens/s/device |

The practice report gives the configuration and calculation methods.

```bash
bash -n examples/otb_trainer/run_qwen2_5_7b_megatron.sh
shellcheck examples/otb_trainer/run_qwen2_5_7b_megatron.sh
pre-commit run --all-files --show-diff-on-failure --color=always
git diff HEAD --check
```

Bash syntax, ShellCheck, all 14 pre-commit checks, and Git diff checks passed.

### API and Usage Example

```bash
MODEL_PATH=/path/to/Qwen2.5-7B \
DATA_ROOT=/path/to/data \
OUTPUT_DIR=/path/to/persistent/output \
bash examples/otb_trainer/run_qwen2_5_7b_megatron.sh
```

Prepare GSM8K/MATH `train.parquet` and `test.parquet` as described in `examples/otb_trainer/README.md`.

### Design & Code Changes

The launch uses the existing Megatron OTB engine and trainer, fixed micro-batches, actor recomputation, and tensor/pipeline parallelism. CANN logging uses error level. The practice report is linked from the Ascend documentation index.

### Checklist Before Submitting

@@ -0,0 +1,111 @@
+# Qwen2.5-7B Optimal Token Baseline on Ascend 910A3
+
+Last updated: 10/15/2026.
+
+Optimal Token Baseline (OTB) uses old-policy token probabilities and squared
+vocabulary probabilities to calculate token-wise advantages. This practice uses
+verl `release/v0.8.0` at `3e4edb6e`, Megatron training, and vLLM-Ascend generation
+on eight Ascend 910A3 devices.
+
+## Environment
+
+The measured environment was based on the official image
+`quay.io/ascend/verl:v0.8.0-cann9.0.0-torch_npu2.9.0.post2-a3-ubuntu22.04-py3.11-vllm`.
+Installation instructions are in the
+[Ascend installation guide](../../../zh/get_start/install_guidance.rst).
+
+| Component | Version |
+| --- | --- |
+| Python / CANN | 3.11.15 / 9.0.0 |
+| PyTorch / torch-npu | 2.9.0 / 2.9.0.post2 |
+| Megatron-Core / MindSpeed | 0.16.2 / 0.16.0 |
+| mbridge / Transformers | 0.15.1 / 5.3.0.dev0 |
+| vLLM / vLLM-Ascend | 0.18.0+empty / 0.18.1.dev45+g35b0fdf7d |
+
+The [A3 Dockerfile](../../../../../docker/ascend/Dockerfile.ascend_9.0.0_a3_v0.8.0)
+installs Transformers from
+[`cc7ab9be`](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/tree/cc7ab9be508ce6ed3637bba9e50367b29b742dc6)
+with `pip install -e .`.
+
+## Training
+
+Download [Qwen2.5-7B](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B) and set
+`MODEL_PATH` to its model directory. From the repository root, preprocess

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Optimal Token Baseline | Qwen2.5-7B base | vLLM rollout | Megatron training | Ascend NPU
+set -euo pipefail
+
+export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
+export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false
+export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
+export OMP_PROC_BIND=false
+export HYDRA_FULL_ERROR=1
+export VERL_LOGGING_LEVEL=INFO
+export RAY_DEDUP_LOGS=0
+export ASCEND_GLOBAL_LOG_LEVEL=3
+unset ASCEND_MODULE_LOG_LEVEL
+export ASCEND_SLOG_PRINT_TO_STDOUT=0
+# CANN Python modules must also be available to rollout worker processes.
+export PYTHONPATH="${ASCEND_HOME_PATH}/python/site-packages:${ASCEND_HOME_PATH}/opp/built-in/op_impl/ai_core/tbe:${PYTHONPATH:-}"
+
+# Ray assigns each worker a single local device rank.
+case "${LOCAL_RANK:-}" in
+    ""|*[!0-9]*) unset LOCAL_RANK ;;
+esac
+
+MODEL_PATH=${MODEL_PATH:-Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B}
+ADV_ESTIMATOR=${ADV_ESTIMATOR:-optimal_token_baseline}
+DATA_ROOT=${DATA_ROOT:-${HOME}/data}
+OUTPUT_DIR=${OUTPUT_DIR:-${PWD}/outputs/qwen2_5_7b_otb}
+NPUS_PER_NODE=${NPUS_PER_NODE:-8}
+
+train_files="['${DATA_ROOT}/gsm8k/train.parquet','${DATA_ROOT}/math/train.parquet']"
+val_files="['${DATA_ROOT}/gsm8k/test.parquet','${DATA_ROOT}/math/test.parquet']"
+
+hydra_args=()
+while (($#)); do
+    case "$1" in
+        --checkpoint_url|--data_url)
+            shift
+            if (($#)); then
+                shift
+            fi
+            ;;
+        --checkpoint_url=*|--data_url=*)
+            shift
+            ;;
+        *)
+            hydra_args+=("$1")
+            shift
+            ;;
+    esac
+done
+
+USER_LOG_DIR=${LOG_DIR:-${OUTPUT_DIR}/logs}
+RUN_STARTED_AT=$(date '+%Y%m%d-%H%M%S')
+RUN_LOG_DIR="${USER_LOG_DIR}/otb_${RUN_STARTED_AT}_pid$$"
+RUN_LOG_FILE="${RUN_LOG_DIR}/trainer.log"
+METRICS_LOG_FILE="${RUN_LOG_DIR}/metrics.log"
+export VERL_FILE_LOGGER_PATH="${METRICS_LOG_FILE}"
+
+mkdir -p "${RUN_LOG_DIR}"
+printf 'Training log directory: %s\n' "${RUN_LOG_DIR}" | tee -a "${RUN_LOG_FILE}"
+printf 'Training stdout/stderr log: %s\n' "${RUN_LOG_FILE}" | tee -a "${RUN_LOG_FILE}"
+printf 'Training metrics JSONL log: %s\n' "${METRICS_LOG_FILE}" | tee -a "${RUN_LOG_FILE}"
+
+set +e
+python3 -m verl.trainer.main_ppo \
+    model_engine=megatron \
+    algorithm.adv_estimator="${ADV_ESTIMATOR}" \
+    algorithm.use_kl_in_reward=False \
+    algorithm.rollout_correction.bypass_mode=False \
+    data.train_files="${train_files}" \
+    data.val_files="${val_files}" \
+    data.train_batch_size=128 \
+    data.max_prompt_length=1024 \
+    data.max_response_length=2048 \
+    data.filter_overlong_prompts=True \
+    data.truncation=error \
+    actor_rollout_ref.model.path="${MODEL_PATH}" \
+    actor_rollout_ref.model.use_remove_padding=True \
+    actor_rollout_ref.model.use_fused_kernels=False \
+    actor_rollout_ref.model.enable_gradient_checkpointing=True \
+    actor_rollout_ref.actor.calculate_sum_pi_squared=True \
+    actor_rollout_ref.actor.optim.lr=1e-6 \
+    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_mini_batch_size=128 \
+    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_micro_batch_size_per_gpu=16 \
+    actor_rollout_ref.actor.use_dynamic_bsz=False \
+    actor_rollout_ref.actor.use_kl_loss=False \
+    actor_rollout_ref.actor.entropy_coeff=0 \
+    actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.tensor_model_parallel_size=4 \
+    actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.pipeline_model_parallel_size=2 \
+    actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.param_offload=False \
+    actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.optimizer_offload=False \
+    actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.override_transformer_config.recompute_granularity=full \
+    actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.override_transformer_config.recompute_method=uniform \
+    actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.override_transformer_config.recompute_num_layers=1 \
+    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.name=vllm \
+    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.log_prob_micro_batch_size_per_gpu=16 \
+    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.tensor_model_parallel_size=2 \
+    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.gpu_memory_utilization=0.6 \
+    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.n=8 \
+    +actor_rollout_ref.rollout.engine_kwargs.vllm.additional_config.ascend_compilation_config.enable_npugraph_ex=False \
+    trainer.device=npu \
+    trainer.use_v1=False \
+    trainer.n_gpus_per_node="${NPUS_PER_NODE}" \
+    trainer.nnodes=1 \
+    trainer.logger='["console","wandb","file"]' \
+    trainer.project_name=verl_grpo_example_gsm8k \
+    trainer.experiment_name=qwen2_5-7b-otb \
+    trainer.default_local_dir="${OUTPUT_DIR}" \
+    trainer.rollout_data_dir="${OUTPUT_DIR}/rollouts" \
+    trainer.validation_data_dir="${OUTPUT_DIR}/validation" \
+    trainer.val_before_train=True \
+    trainer.test_freq=5 \
+    trainer.save_freq=-1 \
+    trainer.total_epochs=15 \
+    trainer.total_training_steps=100 \
+    "${hydra_args[@]}" 2>&1 | tee -a "${RUN_LOG_FILE}"
+training_status=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
+printf 'Training process exit code: %s\n' "${training_status}" | tee -a "${RUN_LOG_FILE}"
+set -e
+exit "${training_status}"
